name: better-auth
title: Better Auth
description: Better Auth on the app's own user tables: server config, session facade, session service, React client, the strategy-aware useSession/signIn/signOut hook, OAuth buttons, provider, and the API route handler.
docs: Better Auth with email/password and GitHub/Google OAuth, reading and writing the app's own `users`, `accounts`, `sessions` and `verificationTokens` tables. Set `DATABASE_URL` and `APP_SECRET` (it derives `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`) or set `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` directly, and `BETTER_AUTH_BASE_URL` if it differs from the site URL. `AUTH_STRATEGY=better-auth` makes it the active strategy behind `@/server/auth`; leave it unset and Better Auth is picked whenever nothing Auth.js-specific is configured. Add `AUTH_GITHUB_ID`/`AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET` and/or `AUTH_GOOGLE_ID`/`AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET` for OAuth. The handler mounts at `/api/better-auth`. Run `pnpm db:push` so the nullable Better Auth columns exist on the auth tables.
